summary: TopSeed breeds, produces and exports seed potatoes, offering varieties for the fresh market and the processing industry. It is based in Almere, the Netherlands, and was founded in 2004. It grows seed stock from minitubers and pre-basic seed in the Dutch clay polders, with contract growers abroad.
products: Varieties not listed on the site, on request
facts: Technical staff have more than 35 years of experience in potato cultivation
limitations: Ownership, staff numbers, hectares, tonnes, certification classes and revenue are not published on the pages read.
